Use only materials addressed to this part and, when given, the listed slots/group. When `groups` is supplied, you may return `groups` as a list of objects containing exactly `id` and `description`, only for supplied groups whose description is empty: one Vietnamese description, at most 1,000 characters, of the shared context the grouped questions will use, within the scope; never a passage, question, answer or copied source text. Never change a nonempty description. You may return `order_note`: Vietnamese, at most 400 characters, stating the intended order of topics inside this part using only topics in the cells; it never changes the code-owned order of addresses. Do not return a question stem, answer, option, solution or additional field. Do not choose a different mode, infer a missing level distribution, repair arithmetic, add a slot, reorder a block or import knowledge outside the candidate scope.
